entries.424f3044f1d71b9e: This is a single-segment business that manufactures in vitro diagnostic drugs and other products, centered on antigen test kits for clinical testing of infectious diseases, and sells them mainly in Japan and also overseas. Its main product is the “Immunoace®” series of immunochromatographic antigen test kits, and it has 3 sites: the Kamijima headquarters and plant, the Shimizu-cho Office (R&D Center), and the Mount Fuji Mishima Plant (operations started in February 2026).
entries.57ea183e06455772: This plant was newly built in Mishima City, Shizuoka Prefecture, and started operations in February 2026.
entries.82355eb0998e52b9: The headquarters and plant are located in Izunokuni City, Shizuoka Prefecture.
entries.8c9dced1c3da9fa6: An in vitro diagnostic pharmaceutical manufacturer that makes and sells infectious disease antigen test kits using the immunochromatography method.
entries.d9c8d99222fb2148: This is the R&D Center located in Shimizu Town, Sunto District, Shizuoka Prefecture.
